Material: Slate blue matte scales, tan leather border, two subdued bronze studs.
Construction: Front yoke + rear half joined by two side straps; no thick metal breastplate.
Geometry: Four visible scale rows; 6-8 large plates per row, no micro-mail.
Variants: Shared torso base; civilian: 3 rows; rider: 4; warden: 5; elder: pale 3.
Animation QA: Check elbow and clavicle clearance; no contact with saddle pommel.

Material: Sand leather, one matte scale panel, dark bronze rings.
Construction: Two diagonal straps cross between shoulder and ribs; 2 side release tabs, 1 center spine anchor.
Geometry: Harness sits on top of cloth but beneath shoulder drape; no backpack mass.
Variants: Scout: lighter; rider: dual saddle tabs; tender: utility attachment; warden: wider straps.
Animation QA: Cannot press into seated spine or interfere with mount/dismount.

Material: Ivory fabric piping, blue slate scales, worn bronze edge.
Construction: Flexible crescent on a soft collar base; single rear fastening with leather tongue.
Geometry: Outer collar reads as one continuous gentle U rather than rigid armor.
Variants: Wanderer: none; pathfinder: half; channeler: blue; elder: ceremonial bronze rim.
Animation QA: Full pitch and head turn; shoulder mantle must slide over, not through.

Material: Blue-gray slate scales with ivory inner lining and one bronze pivot pin.
Construction: Pinned at upper arm / neck strap; soft flex section separates shoulder from torso.
Geometry: Silhouette deliberately compact; asymmetry optional by replacing one with a drape.
Variants: Rider: one cap; warden: two broad caps; elder: both hidden by mantle.
Animation QA: Allow full forward arm extension for lance and wingbank animation.

Material: Matte blue scale, soft linen, narrow bronze seam.
Construction: Open inner upper arm; textile tie at back of bicep; not rigid plate tube.
Geometry: Large clean surface; only two ridges in silhouette.
Variants: Scout: none; rider: left only; warden: matching pair; tender: bare cloth wraps.
Animation QA: Arm twisting and reaching must not pinch elbow or cloak.

Material: Matte blue-gray or sand leather, one bronze strip, cream underwrap.
Construction: Simple one-piece tapered shell over cloth, two leather tie points under forearm.
Geometry: Forearm silhouette uses one broad plane; scales embossed at most twice.
Variants: Wanderer: fabric; rider: one reinforced cuff; warden: bronze rim; elder: blue wrap.
Animation QA: Wrist bending for reins and grip; no contact when hands cross torso.

Material: Warm leather, sand wraps, tiny slate scale pad, no sharp knuckles.
Construction: Separate thumb wrap + wrist tie; palms slightly padded on lance hand.
Geometry: No gauntlet fingers; gloves should still read as hands.
Variants: Scout: cloth tape; rider: reinforced palm; warden: scale back pad; elder: bare.
Animation QA: Must not obscure first-person weapon grip and banner mounting animation.

Material: Cobalt-blue woven sash, worn bronze round clasp, leather lining.
Construction: Cloth belt passes under two small scale slips; buckle at front or left hip.
Geometry: One clean band and clasp; hanging cloth is a separate garment socket.
Variants: Wanderer: plain; rider: saddle latch; tender: pouches; warden: additional scale band.
Animation QA: No bulk at hip hinge or seat; tie tails stow during flight.

Material: Slate scales, linen backing, softly patinated bronze ring attachments.
Construction: Each panel hangs from hip belt ring; independent L/R variants, no connected armor skirt.
Geometry: Read as two purposeful plates rather than skirt armor.
Variants: Scout: left only; rider: narrow bilateral; warden: broader; elder: concealed.
Animation QA: Gap at inner thigh and saddle seat; do not ride over dragon flank.

Material: Scuffed bronze over dark blue leather; cloth at rear joint.
Construction: Elastic-like cloth band at top and below knee, hard shell anterior only.
Geometry: Knee anatomy stays compact under draped cloth.
Variants: Scout: soft wraps; rider: thin cups; warden: bronze-faced; elder: none.
Animation QA: Deep crouch, mount knee clamp, and kneel must remain possible.

Material: Slate dragon scale facing (2 broad bands), tan leather, pale wrap cloth.
Construction: One shallow frontal shell with straps looping behind calf; no metal boot cylinder.
Geometry: Reads as wrapped legs first and armor second.
Variants: Wanderer: no shell; rider: two; warden: reinforced pair; channeler: linen only.
Animation QA: Tucked away from dragon flank; protect boot/cloth from clipping in saddle.

Material: Worn leather, linen underwrap, two matte blue scale slips.
Construction: Three broad strap loops; reinforced heel and sole; foot remains readable.
Geometry: Prefer sandals for standard looks; closed rider shoe available by functional swap.
Variants: Wanderer: sandal; rider: protected toe; warden: short rider boot; elder: formal straps.
Animation QA: Foot must fit stirrup/strap anchor without snagging; no dangling laces.
